name: Hotel Bergkristall
beschreibung: The Hotel Bergkristall welcomes holidaymakers to a sunny, peaceful secluded setting in the scenic high valley of Wildschönau in the Kitzbühel Alps. This distinguished four-star hotel features stylish rooms and suites crafted in a contemporary alpine aesthetic, complete with fine timber finishes, elegant bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, Wi-Fi, and private balconies showcasing views across verdant meadows and soaring peaks. An extensive wellness haven, equipped with a large indoor pool, Finnish sauna, bio sauna, steam room, and tranquil relaxation zones, offers deeply restorative regeneration. The gourmet half-board features generous morning breakfast spreads and multi-course evening dinners spotlighting Tyrolean culinary tradition. The complimentary ski bus stops right at the property, delivering swift transfers to the lifts of Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau. In summer, panoramic hiking and cycling paths start at the door.
kurzbeschreibung: Four-star wellness hotel in the Wildschönau featuring a generous indoor pool, saunas, and half-board Tyrolean dining.
